suggested_evidence: National endorsement and a scoped description of affected people, losses and proposed activities
analyst_check: Identify which decision is required and whose authority it needs
potential_issue: Unclear ownership or a route inferred from an unrelated accreditation
suggested_follow_up: Obtain the applicable route and decision record

suggested_evidence: Dated assessment, assessed entity, covered activities, conditions and follow-up evidence
analyst_check: Match the assessment to the implementing ministry and proposed activity; record scope gaps
potential_issue: An old institutional assessment is assumed to cover a new project
suggested_follow_up: Refer uncovered issues for focused specialist review

suggested_evidence: Proposed desk review scope and reasons for any additional site work
analyst_check: Ask whether missing evidence can be resolved proportionately
potential_issue: A lack of prior assessment is treated as automatic rejection
suggested_follow_up: Propose evidence collection and mitigation with accountable owners

suggested_evidence: Adoption date, effective scope, draft status and superseding decisions
analyst_check: Recheck the authoritative record before applying a provision
potential_issue: A draft template or background paper is described as binding
suggested_follow_up: Separate the applicable rule from a proposed operational design

suggested_evidence: Activity-level risk description, controls, control owner and review date
analyst_check: Connect each concern to an affected activity and an implementable response
potential_issue: Risk register gives labels without evidence or accountable action
suggested_follow_up: Request targeted mitigation evidence; escalate material unresolved issues

suggested_evidence: Illustrative funds-flow map, accounting records, reconciliation and proposed reporting arrangements
analyst_check: Trace a disbursement to its intended use and flag unsupported transitions
potential_issue: A transfer to an intermediary is reported as expenditure reaching beneficiaries
suggested_follow_up: Reconcile the reporting stages and identify the responsible entity

suggested_evidence: Applicable prohibited-practice provisions, relevant findings and response arrangements
analyst_check: Distinguish alleged conduct, substantiated findings and remedial evidence
potential_issue: A concern is converted into an unsupported accusation or dismissed by an aggregate score
suggested_follow_up: Refer the matter through the competent integrity and risk processes

suggested_evidence: Open questions, proposed conditions, deadlines and decision owners
analyst_check: Keep legal, fiduciary and economic judgments individually traceable
potential_issue: Analyst sign-off is mistaken for institutional funding approval
suggested_follow_up: Present unresolved decisions to the authorized decision-maker

suggested_evidence: Applicable instrument policy and source of any proposed terms
analyst_check: Label exploratory loan or guarantee calculations as hypothetical
potential_issue: A sample model is presented as an available FRLD product
suggested_follow_up: Use the approved financing form; treat other designs as policy analysis

suggested_evidence: Cash-flow timing, currency, charges, repayment schedule and contingent obligations
analyst_check: Stress repayment burdens and distinguish beneficiary, sovereign and fund perspectives
potential_issue: Concessionality is equated with debt sustainability
suggested_follow_up: Request the relevant debt and fiscal analysis before a country recommendation

suggested_evidence: Results definitions, baselines, measurement method and applicable selection rules
analyst_check: Keep monitoring indicators separate from the approval rationale
potential_issue: High projected results are treated as sufficient for eligibility
suggested_follow_up: Document results plausibility and the separate policy basis for selection

suggested_evidence: Qualitative loss evidence, affected-group priorities and distribution of proposed benefits
analyst_check: State what financial analysis omits and how that affects the recommendation
potential_issue: Unpriced loss is implicitly given a value of zero
suggested_follow_up: Carry material non-economic and distributional considerations into the decision note
